en: I decided to sell my car.
I didn't decide what I'm going to do.
Did you decide to go abroad with them?
Why didn't you decide quickly?
You decided to change your job.
You didn't decide at the right time.
He decided to stay at home.

lat: huwa ma qerrersh f had l-mawdu3
en: He didn't decide on this subject.
She decided to travel to France.
She didn't decide what to buy today.
We decided to buy a new house.
We didn't decide where we will sit.

lat: wash ntuma qerrertu temshiw l l-7efla
en: Did you decide to go to the party?
You didn't decide on time.
They decided to build a new school.

lat: huma ma qerrerush f had l-qadya
en: They didn't decide on this case.
I decide everything by myself.

lat: ana ma kanqerrersh bla ma nfekker
ar: أنا ما كنقررش بلا ما نفكر
en: I don't decide without thinking.
You always decide quickly.

lat: nta ma katqerrersh f l-weqt ga3
en: You don't decide on time at all.

lat: nti katqerreri f kulshi b rasek
en: You decide on everything by yourself.

lat: nti ma katqerrerish f dak sh-shi
en: You (f.) don't decide on that.
The manager decides everything in the company.

ar: هو ما كيقررش حتى يفكر مزيان
en: He doesn't decide until he thinks well.
She decides everything at home.

lat: hiya ma katqerrersh bla ma tshawer m3ana
ar: هي ما كتقررش بلا ما تشاور معانا
en: She doesn't decide without consulting us.

ar: حنا كنقررو مع بعضنا كل نهار
en: We decide together every day.

ar: حنا ما كنقرروش بلا ما نهضرو
en: We don't decide without talking.

lat: ntuma katqerreru f l-ijtima3 kul simana
en: You (pl.) decide in the meeting every week.

ar: نتوما ما كتقرروش حتى يفوت الوقت
en: You don't decide until the time passes.

ar: هما كيقررو كل نهار حاجة جديدة
en: They decide something new every day.
They don't decide on their own.
I will decide tomorrow in the morning.

lat: ma ghadish nqerrer 7tta l s-simana j-jayya
ar: ما غاديش نقرر حتى للسيمانة الجاية
en: I'm not going to decide until next week.
You are going to decide before Friday.

lat: ma ghadish tqerrer daba wla ghedda
ar: ما غاديش تقرر دابا ولا غدا
en: You are not going to decide now or tomorrow.

lat: nti ghadi tqerreri m3a khtek ghedda
ar: نتي غادي تقرري مع ختك غدا
en: You will decide with your sister tomorrow.

lat: nti ma ghadish tqerreri bla biya
ar: نتي ما غاديش تقرري بلا بيا
en: You are not going to decide without me.

lat: huwa ghadi yqerrer f had l-lila
en: He is going to decide tonight.

lat: huwa ma ghadish yqerrer daba f had sh-shi
ar: هو ما غاديش يقرر دابا فهاد الشي
en: He is not going to decide now on this thing.

lat: hiya ghadi tqerrer qbel ma temshi
ar: هي غادي تقرر قبل ما تمشي
en: She is going to decide before she leaves.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tqerrer 7tta l ghedda
ar: هي ما غاديش تقرر حتى لغدا
en: She is not going to decide until tomorrow.

ar: حنا غادي نقررو مع المدير اليوم
en: We are going to decide with the manager today.

ar: حنا ما غاديش نقررو بلا بيهم
en: We are not going to decide without them.

lat: wash ntuma ghadi tqerreru b z-zerba
en: Are you going to decide quickly?

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tqerreru f had l-weqt
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تقررو فهاد الوقت
en: You are not going to decide at this time.

lat: huma ghadi yqerreru ghedda f l-ijtima3
en: They are going to decide tomorrow in the meeting.

lat: huma ma ghadish yqerreru 7tta l sh-shehr j-jay
ar: هما ما غاديش يقررو حتى للشهر الجاي
en: They are not going to decide until next month.
